name: Chimphobia VR
summary: Chimphobia throws you into a world of oppressive darkness and eerie silence, broken only by the sound of your own footsteps—and the faint, unsettling movement of something in the shadows. Explore damp, winding caves and stumble into hidden research facilities that hide unspeakable experiments. Whatever was created here isn’t human anymore… and it’s watching you.
